name: cursor-supermemory
description: Persistent AI memory for Cursor — powered by Supermemory

skills.name: memory-init
skills.description: Deep codebase exploration to initialize project memory. Use when starting work on a new project or when user asks to "index" or "learn" the codebase.

skills.name: memory-save
skills.description: Save important information to persistent memory. Use when user explicitly asks to remember something, or when you've solved a significant problem worth preserving.

skills.name: memory-search
skills.description: Search persistent memory for relevant information from past coding sessions. Use when user asks about previous work, past bugs, architectural decisions, or anything that may have been worked on before.

subagents.name: supermemory-context-gatherer
subagents.description: Gather deep background from Supermemory before substantial work, resuming old work, or investigating repository history.

rules.name: supermemory
rules.description: Supermemory persistent memory tools — use them proactively

commands.name: supermemory-config
commands.description: Configure Supermemory settings for this project

commands.name: supermemory-setup
commands.description: Connect Supermemory to Cursor for persistent AI memory

commands.name: supermemory-status
commands.description: Check Supermemory authentication and live connectivity
